concerns.text: FR-012 requires that low‑performing (“null”) model results be reported without error. Task T007 aborts the pipeline if no model meets the validation R² lower‑CI ≥ 0.5, preventing a null‑result report and thus weakens FR-012.

FR-005 mandates exactly 1,000 shuffles for the permutation test. Task T009 performs a nested permutation test with 1,000 shuffles per outer CV fold, resulting in >1,000 total shuffles and violating the exact‑shuffle requirement.

Constitution VI defines model success by a cross‑validated R² ≥ 0.5. Task T007 selects the best model using validation‑set R² lower‑CI ≥ 0.5, which does not satisfy the cross‑validation criterion and therefore breaches the constitution.
